candidate.runtime: Python 3.12.3; PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.14.0; Transformers 4.51.3; tokenizers 0.21.4; HIP 7.14.60850; backend pytorch_rocm

decision_policy.evidence_unit: one part across exactly four distinct observations
decision_policy.extraction: take exact nonempty strings from Florence bboxes_labels, polygons_labels, and labels; deduplicate exact repeats within a view only; preserve all raw outputs
decision_policy.supported: all four views each emit exactly one distinct category and that exact string is the same frozen ontology ID in every view
decision_policy.unknown: all four views each emit exactly one distinct category and the exact same nonempty raw category string in every view, and that string is not exactly any frozen ontology ID
decision_policy.ambiguous: all other cases, including a missing category in any view, multiple distinct categories within any view, or disagreement across views
decision_policy.normalization: exact byte-for-byte Python string equality to frozen ontology IDs only; no fuzzy, edit-distance, substring, embedding, or alias matching
decision_policy.confidence: unknown; Florence output has no native calibrated part-role confidence
decision_policy.calibration: none; policy has no tunable thresholds and is fixed before development predictions
decision_policy.rationale: the fixture's frozen unit is one part jointly observed in four views; repeated exact out-of-ontology evidence is the only deterministic unknown rule, while insufficient/conflicting evidence abstains as ambiguous

execution.network: disabled by caller/container; adapter enforces local_files_only and Python network denial during load/generation
